title: HTML structure
summary: Write the skeleton every HTML page shares, then fill it with headings, lists, links, an image with alt text, landmarks, a labeled form, and a table. You will watch the DOM view redraw the tree as each element goes in and see why tags describe what content is, not how it looks.
changeNote: Rewritten so each step opens with an explainer or a prediction, folds the background under Read more, and ends with a quiz.
